species.name: Kaelen
species.physiology: Oxygen-breathing mammalian bipeds adapted to dense orbital cities and mixed-gravity shipboard life.
species.ethos: They prize civic continuity, negotiated law, and practical engineering over heroic individual action.

techProfile.hullAesthetic: clean angular armour plates with blue-white registry markings
techProfile.namingConvention: classical civic names and formal station designators

species.name: Tharkan
species.physiology: Broad-framed mineral-adapted humanoids whose dense bones and redundant organs tolerate harsh frontier gravity.
species.ethos: They value clan obligation, salvage rights, and earned independence from distant central authorities.

techProfile.weaponStyle: rugged projectile weapons and overbuilt defensive systems
techProfile.hullAesthetic: patched rounded hulls with exposed utility trusses and rust-orange panels
techProfile.namingConvention: short industrial callsigns, rig names, and clan-lineage markers

species.name: Veth
species.physiology: Long-lived arboreal symbiotes whose paired nervous systems support exceptional memory and trade calculation.
species.ethos: They treat obligation as a ledger, preserving peace when it improves prosperity and leverage.

techProfile.weaponStyle: precise defensive fire and electronic countermeasures
techProfile.hullAesthetic: sleek green crescent hulls with layered cargo spines
techProfile.namingConvention: apostrophe-linked trade-house names and route titles

species.name: Driftborn
species.physiology: Mixed-lineage spacer enclaves shaped by sealed habitats, cybernetic medicine, and generations away from planets.
species.ethos: They prize survival, anonymity, and flexible loyalty in the shadow economies between formal powers.

techProfile.weaponStyle: improvised mixed batteries, seekers, and stolen military surplus
techProfile.hullAesthetic: mismatched dark hulls built from refitted civilian and military frames
techProfile.namingConvention: aliases, syndicate handles, and ominous station nicknames

factions.name: The Federation
factions.description: A sprawling democratic union of core worlds, known for bureaucracy and reliable trade routes.
factions.shipStyle: Clean angular hulls in blue-white, built for endurance over speed.
factions.missionFlavour: Reliable cargo contracts with fair pay and occasional escort work.
factions.techArchetype: civic patrol and reliable trade logistics

factions.name: Frontier Clans
factions.description: Loose confederacy of independent mining and salvage operations on the outer rim. Distrustful of authority.
factions.shipStyle: Heavy salvaged hulls in rust-orange, patched and overloaded.
factions.missionFlavour: High-risk cargo runs with generous payouts, no questions asked.
factions.techArchetype: salvage industry and rugged frontier conversion

factions.name: Veth Collective
factions.description: An ancient mercantile collective operating from the southern arm. Neutral to most, loyal to profit.
factions.shipStyle: Sleek rounded hulls in deep green, designed for cargo capacity above all.
factions.missionFlavour: Long-haul cargo runs between distant systems, high value and high distance.
factions.techArchetype: mercantile cargo optimization and precise defensive systems

factions.name: The Syndicate
factions.description: Organised piracy network operating from hidden stations in void sectors.
factions.shipStyle: Mismatched salvaged hulls from every faction, bristling with weapons.
factions.missionFlavour: Raids, smuggling, and black market deliveries.
factions.techArchetype: black-market refits and predatory mixed weapons

factions.name: Independent Ports
factions.description: Unaffiliated ports, free captains, and local councils outside the control of larger powers.
factions.shipStyle: Practical mixed hulls with local markings and whatever parts are available.
factions.missionFlavour: Local freight, repair work, and practical contracts without formal faction politics.
factions.techArchetype: local refits and mixed civilian utility craft

hullSpecs.name: Interceptor Mk I
hullSpecs.description: Short-range interceptor archetype. High agility strike craft with minimal sustain systems.

hullSpecs.name: Shuttle Mk I
hullSpecs.description: Small civilian runabout. Modest thrust and a tight equipment bay, but enough cargo space for local freight and ferry work—think Escape Velocity starter hauler, not a dogfighter.

equipmentCatalog.name: Forward Thruster (Standard)
equipmentCatalog.description: Baseline forward propulsion module for light and medium hulls.

equipmentCatalog.name: Forward Thruster (Civilian)
equipmentCatalog.description: Low-output main drive for small shuttles and work craft. Cheaper to run than military-spec units, with less forward push.

equipmentCatalog.name: Forward Thruster (Heavy)
equipmentCatalog.description: High-mass forward propulsion module for heavy hulls and loaded craft.

equipmentCatalog.name: Reverse Thruster (Standard)
equipmentCatalog.description: Baseline reverse-thrust module for controlled deceleration and docking.

equipmentCatalog.name: Reverse Thruster (Heavy)
equipmentCatalog.description: High-mass reverse-thrust module for heavy braking on large ships.

equipmentCatalog.name: Rotation Thruster (Fighter)
equipmentCatalog.description: Low-mass high-response attitude control thruster for fighter-class hulls.

equipmentCatalog.name: Rotation Thruster (Civilian)
equipmentCatalog.description: Modest reaction control for light civilian hulls. Slower to snap than fighter RCS, with a little more mass on the frame.

equipmentCatalog.name: Rotation Thruster (Standard)
equipmentCatalog.description: General-purpose attitude control thruster for non-fighter hulls.

equipmentCatalog.name: Rotation Thruster (Heavy)
equipmentCatalog.description: Heavy-duty attitude control thruster tuned for high-mass hulls.

equipmentCatalog.name: Auto-Brake Module (T1)
equipmentCatalog.description: Inertial damping assist module that stabilizes drift and rotation when engaged.

equipmentCatalog.name: Pulse Cannon (Light)
equipmentCatalog.description: Light direct-fire kinetic weapon. Low mass, reliable baseline gun.

equipmentCatalog.name: Slug Thrower (Medium)
equipmentCatalog.description: Medium kinetic weapon with heavier projectiles and higher mass than pulse cannons.

equipmentCatalog.name: Seeker Missile Launcher (Light)
equipmentCatalog.description: Guided missile launcher for strike loadouts. Heavier than light guns.

equipmentCatalog.name: Plasma Emitter (Light)
equipmentCatalog.description: Light plasma weapon with moderate mass and sustained pressure role.

equipmentCatalog.name: Hull Plating (Light)
equipmentCatalog.description: Light armor package for minor survivability gain at moderate mass.

equipmentCatalog.name: Hull Plating (Heavy)
equipmentCatalog.description: Heavy armor package for maximum survivability at high mass cost.

equipmentCatalog.name: Ablative Plating (Layered)
equipmentCatalog.description: Layered sacrificial armor tuned for mixed damage resistance; high mass profile.

equipmentCatalog.name: Fuel Cell (Standard)
equipmentCatalog.description: General-purpose fuel tank for baseline operational range.

equipmentCatalog.name: Fuel Cell (XS Interceptor)
equipmentCatalog.description: Compact short-range fuel tank for interceptor archetypes.

equipmentCatalog.name: Fuel Cell (S)
equipmentCatalog.description: Compact extended-cell packaging for tight mounts—same capacity class as the extended cell in a smaller hull footprint.

equipmentCatalog.name: Fuel Cell (Extended)
equipmentCatalog.description: Extended-range fuel tank for long-haul routes and high-burn platforms.

equipmentCatalog.name: Power Reactor (Standard)
equipmentCatalog.description: Baseline onboard power reactor for shields and energy systems.

equipmentCatalog.name: Power Reactor (Efficient)
equipmentCatalog.description: Lower-mass efficient reactor optimized for endurance and fuel economy.

equipmentCatalog.name: Shield Emitter (Standard)
equipmentCatalog.description: Standard defensive shield emitter for baseline combat resilience.

equipmentCatalog.name: Shield Emitter (Heavy)
equipmentCatalog.description: High-capacity shield emitter with increased mass and power demand.

equipmentCatalog.name: Hyperspace Drive (Basic)
equipmentCatalog.description: Entry-level jump drive module for inter-sector travel.

missionTemplates.title: Clan Cargo Run

missionTemplates.title: Urgent Clan Shipment
missionTemplates.descriptionTemplate: Rush delivery to {destination}. Don't ask what's in the crates.

missionTemplates.title: Inter-Faction Liaison Cargo

landables.name: Vethos Prime
landables.description: The administrative capital of the Federation's eastern territories. Its sprawling cities never sleep, and the orbital lanes are thick with traffic.

landables.name: Vethos Moon
landables.description: A cold, cratered moon used as a fuel depot and waystation for traffic bound for Vethos Prime.

landables.name: Port Kaelen
landables.description: A Federation trading post and equipment hub. The docking bays are always busy and the prices are fair.

landables.name: Salvage Post 7
landables.description: A cramped outpost bolted together from decommissioned freighter hulls. Smells of welding smoke and recycled air.

landables.name: Relay Station Epsilon
landables.description: A Federation communications relay and refuelling stop. Minimal staff, maximum automation.

landables.name: Derelict Platform
landables.description: An abandoned mining platform, dark and silent. Someone has jury-rigged a fuel line — it works, barely.

landables.name: New Carthage
landables.description: A temperate Federation colony world, younger and rougher than the core worlds but growing fast.

landables.name: Dust
landables.description: A barren, rust-coloured moon the colonists call Dust. Small mining operations cling to its craters.

landables.name: Rig Tharkan
landables.description: The Frontier Clans' de facto capital — a rugged, storm-swept world where self-reliance is the only law.

landables.name: The Heap
landables.description: An orbital collection of welded-together hulks that somehow holds pressure. The Clans' main trading post.

landables.name: Waypost 3
landables.description: A Frontier Clans fuel stop on the route between Rig Tharkan and the outer rim. Nothing more, nothing less.

landables.name: Veth'Ora
landables.description: The Collective's ancient home world. Dense forests cover most of its surface, broken by gleaming trade cities.

landables.name: Exchange Point Kael
landables.description: The Collective's primary trading exchange. Goods from across the galaxy change hands here.

landables.name: Pale Kael
landables.description: A white ice moon orbiting Veth'Ora. Automated drilling rigs extract water ice around the clock.

landables.name: Outpost Sigma
landables.description: Nobody built this station with intention. It just accumulated over decades — modules bolted on as needed, never taken off.

landables.name: The Maw
landables.description: The Syndicate's primary base of operations, hidden in a debris field. Dark, cold, and unwelcoming to outsiders.

landables.name: Lonely Watch
landables.description: An isolated deep-edge outpost with a skeleton crew and long-range scanners watching the void.
